title: Supreme Court imposes ₹3 lakh fine on YouTuber-comedian Samay Raina
description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday imposed a fine of ₹3 lakh each on stand up comic and YouTuber Samay Raina and four others for violating court orders in the case connected to insensitive remarks made on their show about persons with disabilities.A Bench Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana passed the order after it was brought to their notice that Raina had not invited any disabled persons to his show which was one of the directions given by the Court ear
